blocks.text: Kim Chiu went to the Quezon City Hall of Justice to attend the arraignment of her older sister, Lakam Chiu, who faces a qualified theft case filed by the actress-TV host. Kim arrived at the courthouse alongside Lauren Dyogi, the head of ABS-CBN’s talent management arm Star Magic, on Thursday afternoon, Sept. 24. The legal dispute between the sisters arose from alleged “serious financial discrepancies” that Kim discovered in their handbag business in 2025. Lakam was later charged with 124 counts of qualified theft over alleged unauthorized withdrawals and transfers involving about ₱44.4 million in company funds. READ: A look back […]...
